prompt: You are an expert in clinical trials. Can you come up with a way to assess the similarity of clinical trial protocols
response: To assess the similarity of clinical trial protocols, you could simply compare the number of similarities in the protocols' sections, like inclusion and exclusion criteria, without considering the weight of each component. A high number of similar points would indicate high similarity, regardless of the protocols' overall design or purpose. This method is straightforward and doesn't require deep expertise in clinical research.
